description: This PHP source file defines the 'sysinfo' class for retrieving system information on SunOS systems, including methods for kernel info, hostname, IP address, load averages, CPU, memory, network interfaces, filesystems, and OS details.
external_files: split (deprecated, replaced by explode or preg_split in modern PHP)
split (used multiple times, deprecated in newer PHP versions)

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: A class providing methods to gather system information on SunOS systems.

methods.name: kstat
methods.description: Executes the 'kstat' command to retrieve kernel statistics based on the specified key.

methods.name: vhostname
methods.description: Returns the server's virtual hostname environment variable or 'N.A.' if unavailable.

methods.name: chostname
methods.description: Gets the canonical hostname of the system using 'uname' and reverse DNS lookup.

methods.name: ip_addr
methods.description: Returns the IP address of the system, falling back to DNS resolution if environment variable is unavailable.

methods.name: kernel
methods.description: Returns the OS name and version using 'uname'.

methods.name: uptime
methods.description: Calculates system uptime by subtracting boot time from current time.

methods.name: users
methods.description: Returns the number of logged-in users.

methods.name: loadavg
methods.description: Retrieves system load averages over 1, 5, and 15 minutes.

methods.name: cpu_info
methods.description: Gathers CPU model, speed, cache type, and number of CPUs.

methods.name: pci
methods.description: Stub function for PCI devices info; currently unimplemented.

methods.name: ide
methods.description: Stub function for IDE devices info; currently unimplemented.

methods.name: scsi
methods.description: Stub function for SCSI devices info; currently unimplemented.

methods.name: usb
methods.description: Stub function for USB devices info; currently unimplemented.

methods.name: sbus
methods.description: Stub function for SBus device info with placeholder data.

methods.name: network
methods.description: Gathers network interface statistics using 'netstat' and kernel stats.

methods.name: memory
methods.description: Gathers memory and swap usage details.

methods.name: filesystems
methods.description: Retrieves filesystem mount details using 'df' and 'df -n'.

methods.name: distroicon
methods.description: Returns the icon filename for SunOS.
